verdict.rationale: Unleash has a dedicated guide for releasing a feature at a specific date and time, using a `currentTime` constraint with the `DATE_AFTER` operator. Change requests can also group flag changes and apply them at a specific point in time, which covers scheduling broader flag changes. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of scheduled change requests (only a single line), any independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling working as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: to release a feature at a specific date and time (for a product launch, for instance)
Add a date-based constraint by selecting the `currentTime` context field (step 1 in the below image), choosing the `DATE_AFTER` operator
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
